	["Metadiastima Photoemission Tube"]={name="Metadiastima Photoemission Tube", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A synthetic item for detecting and verifying various field forces and actions at a distance. 	["D96 Steel Sample 4"]={name="D96 Steel Sample 4", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A novel and artificial alloy of D32 steel and D64 steel that cannot exist naturally. 	["Tachyon Screening Lattice"]={name="Tachyon Screening Lattice", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="An ion trap that might be leveraging its innate Æther properties. 	["Quadrant Fitting Fluid"]={name="Quadrant Fitting Fluid", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A hypothetical condensed matter in fluid state. 	["Triphasic Nanoflake"]={name="Triphasic Nanoflake", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A device that is extremely sensitive to ambient Originium. 	["Warp Plasma-Coated Slide"]={name="Warp Plasma-Coated Slide", tier=5, use="A rare material for operator promotion, weapon tuning, and operator skill mastery.", desc="A plasma distilled and homogenized from a mysterious crystalline material discovered on Talos-II within the recent decade.
